query: Which quantitative fairness metrics and monitoring thresholds will detect dialect/register bias, and what sampling/weighting remediation will we apply?

response.query: Which quantitative fairness metrics and monitoring thresholds will detect dialect/register bias, and what sampling/weighting remediation will we apply?
response.answer: Quantitative fairness metrics include demographic parity and equalized odds; remediation uses stratified sampling and inverse probability weighting.

Section 101(b) of the Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act of 2015 (MACRA) sunset the Medicare EHR Incentive Program for Eligible Professionals, set forth at section 1848(o) of the Act.
